title: General Knowledge Sample
description: A short demo quiz covering all three question types and a shared scenario.
author: QuizApp

scenarios.title: Scenario: Planning a Garden
scenarios.text: Maya is planting a vegetable bed that gets about 3 hours of direct sun each morning and is shaded the rest of the day. The soil stays damp for days after rain. She wants a harvest within two months of planting.

questions.prompt: The Pacific is the largest ocean on Earth.
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean covers more area than all of Earth's landmass combined.

questions.prompt: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red because of iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are prime numbers?
questions.explanation: 2, 7, and 11 are prime. 4 = 2 x 2 and 9 = 3 x 3.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was purpose-built as the capital in a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.prompt: Sound travels faster in water than in air.
questions.explanation: Sound travels about 4x faster in water (~1480 m/s) than in air (~343 m/s).

questions.prompt: Which crop best suits Maya's bed?
questions.explanation: Only lettuce fits all three conditions: partial shade, damp soil, and a harvest inside two months.

choices.text: Tomatoes, which need 6 to 8 hours of direct sun
Watermelon, which needs about 90 warm, sunny days
Leaf lettuce, which tolerates partial shade and matures quickly
Rosemary, which prefers full sun and dry, fast-draining soil

questions.prompt: Raising the bed a few inches would help with the soil condition described.
questions.explanation: Soil that stays damp for days drains poorly. A raised bed lifts the roots above the wettest soil.
